name: clickplane-console
description: AI-assisted ClickHouse console with live SQL, schema discovery, PromQL exploration, and real-time query workflows.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "yarn workspace @clickplane/api dev" "yarn workspace @clickplane/web dev"
scripts.dev:clickhouse: CLICKPLANE_EXECUTOR=clickhouse CLICKHOUSE_URL=http://localhost:8123 CLICKHOUSE_USERNAME=default CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD=clickplane-local concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "yarn workspace @clickplane/api dev" "yarn workspace @clickplane/web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @clickplane/api typecheck && yarn workspace @clickplane/web build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @clickplane/api typecheck && yarn workspace @clickplane/web typecheck
